description: Airports Locations Data is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Upply. Upply's Airports Locations Data identifies the main logistics airports around the world, with their precise geographical coordinates and standardised information facilitating their identification and use in logistics solutions. Each registration includes in particular the name of the airport, its IATA code, its country, as well as its coordinates (latitude, longitude). Coverage: Upply. The publisher named on the listing is Upply. Its keywords include transport-aerien, transport, coordonnees-geographiques, logistique, localisation, aeroports. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, DOCX. The listing shows 2025-11-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
